_comment: Measured accuracy per agent, used by the 'measured_accuracy' part of the confidence score. Add one entry per test run: correct = cases the agent got right, total = cases checked. Reliability = (all correct + 1) / (all total + 2); an agent with no entries counts as 50%. Restart the orchestrator after editing.
